image_description: A close-up underwater photograph of a Rock Beauty angelfish (Holocanthus tricolor). The fish displays the characteristic black anterior head and chest, transitioning to a golden-yellow posterior body with a distinct black vertical band separating the two colors. The fins are yellow with blue margins. The background consists of blurred blue water and indistinct reef structures.

The caudal fin (tail) appears rounded or slightly truncate, consistent with the species.

The background blur is very smooth and lacks the complex bokeh characteristics of a real camera lens, appearing more like a Gaussian blur applied in post-processing or by a generative model.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species identification (Holocanthus tricolor) vs other angelfish or butterflyfish, as visual similarities exist.
To check for edge bleeding between the yellow fins and the blue water, and to ensure the fins are topologically connected to the body without melting.
To assess the overall realism of the lighting, shadows, and water refraction effects which are common failure points in AI-generated underwater scenes.
